description: Android Fragment class 'DetailFragment' that displays detailed recipe information including image, metadata, ingredients, and instructions. It manages UI components, observes ViewModel state, and handles user interactions.

classes.name: DetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays detailed information about a recipe, including image, metadata, ingredients, and instructions. It manages UI updates based on ViewModel state and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and its ViewModel, retrieves recipe ID from arguments.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, buttons, and observes ViewModel state, then loads the recipe.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns UI components from the inflated view.

methods.name: setupButtons
methods.description: Sets click listeners for back and favorite buttons.

methods.name: observeViewModel
methods.description: Collects UI state from ViewModel and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: showRecipe
methods.description: Populates UI with recipe data, including image, metadata, ingredients, and instructions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DetailFragment with specified recipe ID.
